rasterAssets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG action-tile atlas for a personal expense app. Four separate square button tiles in one wide row: save entry, retry entry, add entry, add location. Match a tactile warm-cream pressed-paper surface, shallow inset rim, soft upper-left contact shadow, deep muted sage glyphs, and a restrained warm-yellow accent. All four are identical default raised states; no focus or disabled styling baked in. Genuine transparent alpha outside tiles and in gaps; no checkerboard. No text, amounts, addresses, success claims, logos, glossy plastic, harsh outlines, edge halos, or watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG personalization badge atlas for a personal expense app. Eight separate circular cream-paper badges: leaf, sun, moon, star, shared-circle, sparkle, bookmark, and paired dots. Tactile raised/inset material, muted sage symbols, tiny warm-yellow accents, isolated objects, genuine alpha outside each badge. Decorative only: no face, name, letter, number, verification, rank, permission, lock, or watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG state-card-frame atlas. Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG atlas of six reusable empty and recovery state tiles in a 3 by 2 grid: empty ledger, empty filter, no import result, file needs replacement, account link expired or conflict, and no location. Match warm cream pressed-paper material, subtle microtexture, soft raised square tile, deep muted sage symbols, and restrained warm-yellow accents. True transparent alpha in the gaps and outside each tile; no checkerboard. No text, amounts, addresses, names, permission claims, success checkmarks, logos, glossy plastic, hard outlines, or watermark. Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: transparent PNG visual-reference atlas (not a production CSS background) for a responsive numeric keypad in the existing for. expense app. Create twelve separate horizontal blank keycap surfaces in a 3 by 4 grid, each with a roughly 2.7:1 landscape ratio rather than a square: warm cream pressed-paper microtexture, shallow inset rim, soft upper-left contact shadow, deep muted sage edge, and restrained warm-yellow detail on utility surfaces. The atlas is for visual review of a 3-column responsive grid at desktop, mobile, and compact widths; it must not encode a fixed pixel size and must be cropped/overlaid only as a reference. Genuine transparent alpha outside every keycap and in all gaps, no checkerboard. No digits, letters, C, period, backspace icon, font, labels, amounts, logos, glossy plastic, hard outlines, strong gradients, halo, or watermark. Keep every cell aligned and preserve the same relative proportions so HTML/SVG can overlay dynamic content and accessible labels. Do not use the whole atlas as a CSS background.

Use case: ui-mockup and motion reference. Asset type: transparent PNG visual-reference atlas (not a production CSS background) of eight blank horizontal numeric-keycap animation frames in a 4 by 2 grid. Frame order left-to-right, top-to-bottom: rest, hover, touch, deepest press, hold, release, rebound, settle. Keep one consistent landscape keycap ratio around 2.7:1 and consistent transparent bounds across every frame so reviewers can compare desktop, mobile, and compact keypad widths; do not treat the atlas pixels as a responsive size contract. Show only subtle changes in inset depth, contact shadow, scale impression, and sage paper texture; use the existing warm cream, deep sage, and tiny warm-yellow palette. No digits, letters, fixed font, labels, C, period, backspace, text, amounts, logos, checkerboard, glossy 3D, hard outlines, strong gradients, edge halo, or watermark. This is a visual reference only; production accessibility and smooth interpolation come from HTML/CSS transforms and shadows. Do not use the whole atlas as a CSS background.
